What the New Joinee Will Do: Map Well-being responsibilities against Mentor, SC, TL, Principal, teacher and external professionals.
Competency Standard: Clarifies role, scope and boundaries.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Respond to 8-10 situations involving confidentiality, student requests, parents, teachers, academic concerns, behaviour and wellbeing.
Competency Standard: Makes safe boundary decisions without critical errors.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Respond to 5 scenarios: what remains confidential, what must be shared, and with whom.
Competency Standard: No critical confidentiality/safeguarding error; identifies correct escalation.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Create a one-page set of professional non-negotiables.
Competency Standard: Shows understanding of professional boundaries and responsibilities.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Understand Classroom Guidance → Intentional Guidance → Individual Support → Specialised Intervention.
Competency Standard: Explains purpose and sequence.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Work through a complete JS referral pathway using a case.
Competency Standard: Correctly follows pathway and identifies stakeholders.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Work through teacher, parent and student referral routes.
Competency Standard: Correctly follows pathway and escalation points.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Respond to 8-10 cases and decide: monitor / intervene / collaborate / refer / escalate.
Competency Standard: At least 80% appropriate decisions; no critical escalation error.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Identify who needs to be involved at each stage.
Competency Standard: Correctly identifies relevant stakeholders.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Locate intervention forms, counselor entry forms, case history and relevant records.
Competency Standard: Can independently locate and use required systems.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Complete a case record using an approved case after TL review.
Competency Standard: Documentation is objective, relevant, confidential and complete.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Review a case note for objectivity, relevance, confidentiality and completeness; correct errors.
Competency Standard: Identifies and corrects documentation errors.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Observe one student across a structured context.
Competency Standard: Separates observable behaviour from interpretation.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Observe a second student/context different from the first.
Competency Standard: Separates observation from interpretation.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Conduct a structured conversation to understand the student's perspective.
Competency Standard: Uses appropriate questions; preserves student agency.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Speak with relevant teacher/Mentor/MOM to gather contextual information.
Competency Standard: Gathers multiple perspectives without premature conclusions.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Record strengths, presenting concern, patterns, contributing factors, protective factors, assumptions and missing information.
Competency Standard: Distinguishes observation from interpretation; identifies missing information; avoids labels.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Present the case to TL and revise formulation based on feedback.
Competency Standard: Can defend reasoning and incorporate feedback.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Observe counselling session focusing on structure and flow.
Competency Standard: Identifies opening, middle, closure and purpose.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Observe counselling session focusing on listening and attending.
Competency Standard: Identifies effective listening behaviours.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Observe counselling session focusing on questioning.
Competency Standard: Identifies appropriate versus leading/over-directive questions.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Observe counselling session focusing on intervention choices.
Competency Standard: Connects intervention to presenting concern.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Observe counselling session focusing on closure and follow-up.
Competency Standard: Identifies purposeful closure and next steps.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Practise paraphrasing, summarising, reflecting emotion, open questioning and use of silence.
Competency Standard: Demonstrates core micro-skills with appropriate timing.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Respond to a reluctant student.
Competency Standard: Builds rapport without forcing disclosure.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Respond to a defensive or angry student.
Competency Standard: Maintains calm, boundaries and student dignity.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Respond to an emotionally overwhelmed student.
Competency Standard: Provides containment, assesses immediate concern and escalates appropriately.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Respond when a student repeatedly says 'I don't know'.
Competency Standard: Uses appropriate prompts without interrogating.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Respond to a student seeking direct advice.
Competency Standard: Supports student agency rather than becoming directive.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Complete the school's required trauma-informed intervention learning/certification, where applicable.
Competency Standard: Applies trauma-informed principles appropriately; understands limits of role.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Complete the school's required Motivational Interviewing learning/certification, where applicable.
Competency Standard: Uses MI-consistent communication rather than persuasion.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Observe one adult meeting with focus on consultation and professional communication.
Competency Standard: Communicates objectively and maintains confidentiality.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Observe one parent meeting with focus on boundaries and communication.
Competency Standard: Maintains boundaries and avoids overpromising.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Conduct a real student counselling session under observation.
Competency Standard: Meets minimum safe counselling standard; no critical error.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Receive feedback and identify 2-3 specific improvement goals.
Competency Standard: Can identify concrete changes rather than generic reflection.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Re-conduct a session after feedback, demonstrating improvement.
Competency Standard: Demonstrates measurable improvement against agreed goals.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Identify what was missed, assumed and changed after feedback.
Competency Standard: Shows accurate self-observation and learning.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Discuss a student concern without diagnosing or labelling.
Competency Standard: Communicates objectively and protects student dignity.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Respond when a parent asks for diagnosis, immediate action or a guarantee.
Competency Standard: Maintains boundaries; does not diagnose or overpromise.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Respond when a parent disagrees with the counsellor's recommendation.
Competency Standard: Explains rationale, listens, maintains boundaries and seeks consultation.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Explain why referral is recommended, the process and the counsellor's continuing role.
Competency Standard: Correctly identifies need for external support and explains role boundaries.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Define what change/progress would look like for a case.
Competency Standard: Goals are clear, realistic and linked to formulation.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Conduct at least one supervised intervention/session.
Competency Standard: Intervention is appropriate and linked to case formulation.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Review progress with student and relevant stakeholders.
Competency Standard: Follow-up occurs and evidence is documented.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Modify intervention when evidence suggests it is not working.
Competency Standard: Uses evidence to modify intervention.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Decide whether to continue, modify, close or refer and justify the decision.
Competency Standard: Decision is justified and appropriately escalated.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Observe one Life Class, ideally from a different section/grade.
Competency Standard: Identifies purpose, facilitation and engagement strategies.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Observe a second Life Class, ideally a different programme/grade.
Competency Standard: Identifies age/context adaptations.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Examine how student/teacher needs inform Life Class topics.
Competency Standard: Links topic choice to identified need.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Design a Life Class with objective, activity, facilitation plan, engagement and evidence of learning.
Competency Standard: Clear purpose, age appropriateness and meaningful engagement.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Rehearse the session for TL/team.
Competency Standard: Facilitates clearly and adapts appropriately.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Improve the Life Class based on feedback.
Competency Standard: Makes meaningful changes rather than cosmetic edits.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Conduct an actual Life Class where appropriate.
Competency Standard: Engages students and adapts rather than simply following a script.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Collect evidence of student/teacher response and reflect on effectiveness.
Competency Standard: Uses evidence to identify what to retain/change.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Identify 3 principles from the handbook and demonstrate where they apply in practice.
Competency Standard: Connects principles to actual practice.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Complete at least 5 relevant modules and discuss application with TL.
Competency Standard: Demonstrates application rather than submission alone.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Analyse a counselling demonstration for specific counsellor behaviours.
Competency Standard: Identifies specific behaviours and their impact.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Complete selected relevant topics such as sexuality education, learning disabilities, cyber safety and POCSO.
Competency Standard: Understands school-relevant content and application.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Use selected resources such as Dibs/Tarshi books as supporting professional learning.
Competency Standard: Connects learning to practice.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Review an active supervised case with TL: formulation, intervention, follow-up and next step.
Competency Standard: Demonstrates coherent case management and knows when to seek supervision.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Audit documentation from an active supervised case and correct any gaps.
Competency Standard: Objective, relevant, confidential and complete.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Participate in an appropriate teacher/parent/stakeholder conversation under supervision.
Competency Standard: Communicates objectively, maintains boundaries and protects confidentiality.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Discuss one applied learning point with TL and identify how it changes practice.
Competency Standard: Demonstrates transfer from learning to practice.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Complete scenario-based viva on school policies, values, boundaries, confidentiality and escalation.
Competency Standard: No critical error; knows school-specific procedures.

Task / Activity: Case Referral in Presence of Experienced Counsellor
What the New Joinee Will Do: Work through an actual/representative referral process with an experienced counsellor and complete observation.
Competency Standard: Correctly identifies pathway, stakeholders and escalation.

What the New Joinee Will Do: Complete referral/concern → information gathering → student voice → formulation → goal → intervention → collaboration → documentation → follow-up → outcome → closure/next step.
Competency Standard: Integrated, safe and coherent professional judgement.

Training Topic: 10. Final Professional Readiness Demonstration - Graduation Presentation
What the New Joinee Will Do: Conduct an independent session with an actual student where appropriate.
Competency Standard: Meets competent standard across counselling skills; no critical error.

Training Topic: 10. Final Professional Readiness Demonstration - Graduation Presentation
What the New Joinee Will Do: Present and defend professional decisions.
Competency Standard: Explains reasoning, evidence, limitations and next steps.

Training Topic: 10. Final Professional Readiness Demonstration - Graduation Presentation
What the New Joinee Will Do: Respond to an unexpected development/change in a case.
Competency Standard: Adapts safely, escalates appropriately and maintains boundaries.

Training Topic: 10. Final Professional Readiness Demonstration - Graduation Presentation
What the New Joinee Will Do: Answer scenario-based questions covering role, boundaries, intervention and referral.
Competency Standard: Demonstrates independent professional judgement.

Training Topic: 10. Final Professional Readiness Demonstration - Graduation Presentation
What the New Joinee Will Do: Demonstrate knowledge of the school's CPP and post-vention SOP through scenario-based assessment.
Competency Standard: Correctly follows school SOP and escalation requirements.

Training Topic: 10. Final Professional Readiness Demonstration - Graduation Presentation
What the New Joinee Will Do: Reflect on learning, professional growth and strategies that could be used by the team.
Competency Standard: Shows accurate self-assessment and identifies transferable practice.

Training Topic: 10. Final Professional Readiness Demonstration - Graduation Presentation
What the New Joinee Will Do: Present one strategy/learning that could be applied in the team; format/stakeholders to be decided by school.
Competency Standard: Clear, relevant and useful contribution to team learning.

Training Topic: 10. Final Professional Readiness Demonstration - Graduation Presentation
What the New Joinee Will Do: Review complete training evidence with TL before final sign-off.
Competency Standard: All mandatory evidence present; unresolved gaps identified.

Training Topic: 10. Final Professional Readiness Demonstration - Graduation Presentation
What the New Joinee Will Do: Principal reviews competency summary, critical gates and TL recommendation.
Competency Standard: Confirms institutional readiness for independent practice.

Training Topic: 10. Final Professional Readiness Demonstration - Graduation Presentation
What the New Joinee Will Do: Set ongoing supervision arrangement and first review point after onboarding.
Competency Standard: Counsellor has an identified supervisor and review cadence.
